Sasha (PM): Quick sync: re-prioritizing Optimize toolkit features—focus on batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Customer asks: cut token cost, <100ms P95 mobile, and faster regression detection. Proposing three priority lanes: Cost (batch+quant), Latency (adaptive batching + routing), Quality (eval alerts + baselines). Need concrete launch gates by EOW. Thoughts?

Mike (Eng): Agreed. Split batching work: server-side dynamic batching (bigger wins) vs mobile/client-side heuristics (lower risk). Dynamic requires runtime changes and can affect tail latency.

Linda (ML): Quant rollout must be fist-class: profile models (fp16, q4, int8), measure quality deltas per-task. Recommend initial scope: Llama2 variants + two top community models. Build eval harness first.

Anna (Solutions): Customers want simple UX: a "cost vs latency" slider with presets and a migration checklist for Dedicated. Include examples (RetailCo wants 30% token cut target).

Tom (SRE): Note hazard: batching can raise P99. Require canary + per-route P95/P99 dashboards, token-cost telemetry, and circuit-breaker SLOs. Define automated rollback triggers.

Sasha (PM): Draft minimal gates: 1) Quant perf matrix for top-3 models; 2) Batching policy + SLO override and canary path; 3) Eval-alerts prototype with sample policies and runbook; 4) Console "cost vs latency" presets + docs. Anything missing?

Mike (Eng): Add explicit rollout metrics and stop thresholds: token reduction %, P95/P99 ceilings, allowed eval score delta. Will draft spec.

Linda (ML): Use relative thresholds per-customer (e.g., recall drop <2%). Avoid brittle generic metrics; prefer task-specific evals + periodic human checks.

Anna (Solutions): I'll map customers to lanes: AcmeHealth=accuracy-first, RetailCo=cost-first, StartupX=mobile-first. Will produce impact matrix.

Tom (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24h; rollback if eval-alert rate >2% or P99 delta >50ms. Add KV-cache correctness chaos test.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created epic RDW-1423 https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1423 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Mike+Linda produce tech spec & bench plan by Tue EOD. Anna owns impact matrix. Tom authors SLO guardrails + rollout recipe. Prioritization workshop Wed 10am.

Mike (Eng): I'll run experiment q4a quant + prefix caching on 10% traffic first.

Linda (ML): Starting benchmarks; sample snippet: ```bash
python bench.py --model llm-2 --quant q4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 100
```

Tom (SRE): I'll add dashboards (per-route token cost, P95/P99, eval-alert count) and a short runbook with automated rollback steps.

Sasha (PM): Keep updates here. Aim for at most 4 clear gates so sales/customer success can communicate expectations. :+1:
